# Shortcut

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

An Apple Shortcuts app automation - a user-defined sequence of actions run manually, scheduled, or triggered via Siri or other events.

## Scope note

Shortcuts used as capture entry points into PKM workflows, distinct from the Python/Swift scripts implementing the underlying logic.
